cue.comment: This hack of manually assigning targets is necessary. Otherwise the PAR destroyer would be waaay to sticky on fighting the unarmed station. Without this hack, the scenario is an auto-win for the ARG. Even if the player decides to not even participate in combat.

create_order.comment: 'execution chance' AND 'random target selection' to reduce the scenario's difficulty. Even with 'execution chance', all destroyer will eventually turn away from the station towards attacking other destroyers over time, as this cue repeats itself! It basically reduces the PAR destroyer's reaction time drastically.
